note: Advisories that cannot be fixed by a bump here. Each entry names why; `yolo update deps inventory` lists them as held instead of open. Re-check on every inventory: remove the entry as soon as the blocker moves.

holds.name: yara-x
holds.reason: optional `yara` feature of aphrody-re. The fix for GHSA-2jx3-ff3v-j7jj lands in 1.19.0, but 1.19 to 1.21 need wasmtime ^43 to ^45, which carry RUSTSEC-2026-0222/0269/0316 (fixed only from 46.0.3). 1.7.0 keeps wasmtime 36.0.16 (patched). Rules are not deserialised from untrusted input.

holds.name: bincode
holds.reason: RUSTSEC-2025-0141 is an unmaintained notice; 3.0.0 is not a drop-in replacement. Transitive (heed-types and others).

holds.name: glib
holds.reason: gtk3-rs 0.18 stack required by tauri/wry on Linux (atk, cairo-rs, gdk); moves with the Tauri toolchain.

holds.name: quick-xml
holds.reason: 0.38.4 comes from plist 1.7.4; 0.31.0 from an older transitive parent. Moves with its parent.

holds.name: ttf-parser
holds.reason: fontdb 0.16 and the usvg/rustybuzz text stack; no patched release exists for 0.25.1 either.

holds.name: paste
holds.reason: unmaintained notice, transitive (rav1e, specta, safer-bytes); no replacement release.

holds.name: rsa
holds.reason: RUSTSEC-2023-0071 has no patched release; transitive of jsonwebtoken 10.

holds.name: serial
holds.reason: unmaintained notice; portable-pty 0.8 (pinned, 0.9 breaks headless Windows clients).

holds.name: rustybuzz
holds.reason: usvg and athena-text text stack; no newer release.

holds.name: proc-macro-error
holds.reason: unmaintained notice; used by glib-macros and gtk3-macros.

holds.name: proc-macro-error2
holds.reason: unmaintained notice; used by nu-derive-value.

holds.name: encoding
holds.reason: unmaintained notice, transitive; no newer release.

holds.name: number_prefix
holds.reason: unmaintained notice, transitive; no newer release.

holds.name: atomic-polyfill
holds.reason: unmaintained notice, transitive; no newer release.

holds.name: esbuild
holds.reason: 0.27/0.21/0.18 are pinned by vite and tool ranges that exclude 0.28; the advisories concern the esbuild dev server only.

holds.name: vite
holds.reason: vite 5.4 is a transitive dependency of tooling that has not moved to vite 7+; dev server only.

holds.name: uuid
holds.reason: uuid 9 is a transitive major; only v3/v5/v6 with a caller-supplied buffer is affected.

holds.name: basic-ftp
holds.reason: transitive major (5 to 6); moves with its consumer.

holds.name: extract-zip
holds.reason: no newer release (2.0.1 is latest).

holds.name: quill
holds.reason: no newer release (2.0.3 is latest).
